name: dsh-spec-loop
description: Composer toggle that pins a selectable library of constraints into the conversation as one <spec-loop>-tagged user message, per session. Each item pairs a Chinese source with the English product that is actually injected, with model-backed translation between them. Host: agent/pre-step injection + loopback JSON API; Client: a Spec Loop pill plus a two-pane manager in the composer tool row.
